# LectureText

This release includes the Windows installer and an unsigned macOS .dmg.

## What's new

- Generate PDF on each note in the course list, as well as inside a note.
- A student can save their own Groq key. It stays on their computer and is sent only to Groq.
- The create-notes module list orders lecture numbers, so Lecture 5 comes before Lecture 10.

## Install on Windows

1. Download the Windows installer from this release.
2. Run the installer.
3. Open LectureText.

## Install on macOS

1. Download the unsigned macOS .dmg from this release.
2. Open the disk image and move LectureText into Applications.
3. Allow the unsigned app once in System Settings, under Privacy & Security, then open LectureText.
